# Mend
Automated design QA for AI-built apps. Mend crawls a live app, finds UI/UX
issues, and helps you review and ship them fixed.

## About
- Product: Mend
- One-liner: Automated design QA for AI-built apps
- Status: Pre-launch, waitlist open at https://mendit.net
- Audience: product designers and founders shipping AI-built apps
